attempts.summary: Bandwidth-limited node2's traffic through node1 to ~1 Mbit/s in each direction using Linux tc (HTB) on node1's br-lan bridge, while node1's own traffic remains unshaped. Persisted the shaping via an OpenWrt hotplug script so it survives reboot, then completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart-and-recovery protocol for all three nodes with proven boot-identity changes.
